HOSTING_STABILITY_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the stability dimension: hosting.stability.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

text.en: The plugin was soaked for fewer cycles than the floor needs. Soak it for enough cycles before trusting the result.
text.ca: El connector s’ha deixat en remull durant menys cicles dels que calen com a mínim. Deixeu-lo en remull els cicles necessaris abans de confiar en el resultat.

text.en: Something crashed during the run, but not a plugin that could be identified. Narrow down which plugin crashed before trusting any of them.
text.ca: Alguna cosa s’ha avortat durant l’execució, però no s’ha pogut identificar quin connector. Determineu quin connector ha fallat abans de confiar en cap d’ells.

text.en: This plugin crashed during the run. Don’t host it until it’s fixed.
text.ca: Aquest connector s’ha avortat durant l’execució. No l’allotgeu fins que no estigui arreglat.

stabilityCalleeSavedClobbered.doc: the plugin returned from a call with a callee-saved register changed (0.26.2): the host's guard put it back, but not the other members' state in the same process, so the plugin runs only in a worker of its own

text.en: This plugin returned from a call having changed a register it should have preserved. The host put the register back, but other plugins sharing its process were not protected, so it now runs only in a worker of its own.
text.ca: Aquest connector ha retornat d’una crida havent canviat un registre que hauria de preservar. L’amfitrió l’ha restaurat, però els altres connectors que compartien el seu procés no han quedat protegits, i per això ara només funciona en un worker propi.

stabilityCrashedLive.doc: the plugin crashed live on this rig

text.en: This plugin crashed live on this rig. Don’t host it on this rig until it’s fixed.
text.ca: Aquest connector s’ha avortat en viu en aquest equip. No l’allotgeu en aquest equip fins que no estigui arreglat.

text.en: This plugin links a GUI toolkit, which this host does not run headless. Run it where a GUI toolkit is safe, or use a plugin without one.
text.ca: Aquest connector enllaça un kit d’eines de GUI, que aquest amfitrió no fa anar sense pantalla. Feu-lo anar on sigui segur un kit d’eines de GUI, o useu un connector que no en tingui.

text.en: The plugin failed its soak test at this sample rate. Don’t trust it at this rate until it’s fixed.
text.ca: El connector ha fallat la prova de remull a aquesta freqüència de mostreig. No hi confieu a aquesta freqüència fins que no estigui arreglat.

text.en: The plugin completed its soak test. It held up over the run.
text.ca: El connector ha completat la prova de remull. S’ha mantingut estable durant l’execució.

text.en: This plugin spawns its own threads. Watch it for behaviour a host does not control.
text.ca: Aquest connector crea fils propis. Vigileu-lo per si té un comportament que l’amfitrió no controla.

text.en: This plugin’s stability has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.
text.ca: L’estabilitat d’aquest connector no s’ha mesurat. Mesureu-la abans de confiar-hi.

text.en: This plugin has not been soaked. Soak it before trusting it over a long run.
text.ca: Aquest connector no s’ha deixat en remull. Deixeu-lo en remull abans de confiar-hi en una execució llarga.
